source: Local partition of the PLAT-4a global OpenAlex pages (works.parquet and work_regions.parquet, from scripts/partition_global.py). Country rows come from institution and author country codes; registry region rows come from the region predicate in regions/_registry.yml.

what_this_is_and_is_not.is: Counts of unscreened query hits: OpenAlex works that match the active plastics query, grouped by the countries of their authors' institutions (and author country codes), by publication year, PubMed id presence, retraction flag and primary topic.
what_this_is_and_is_not.is_not: Not a relevance-screened count and not a share of world research. A work with authors in two countries is counted in both, and the registry region rows are matched by the region predicate, not the curated corpus of that region. Tier C counts are small and unstable.

retractions: Not counted. Retracted works are not in this data set: the source's list results leave them out, so a retraction share here would read as a false zero.
